summary: On paper Seattle has the edge (Seattle ranks 9th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.11). The model favors Seattle at 68%, mostly on passing matchup (2.5 pts) and rushing matchup (2.1 pts).

SEA.detail: Seattle ranks 9th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.11). Washington's defense ranks 21st (+0.09 allowed).

WAS.detail: Washington's defense ranks 21st in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.09 allowed). Seattle ranks 9th (+0.11).

team_cards.t1: Washington has the 6th-worst defense vs motion.
team_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · FTN CHARTING VIA NFLVERSE
team_cards.note: Garbage time removed · SEA: n=26 dropbacks

model.summary: Model: Seattle 68% to win, fair line SEA -5.5. Market: Seattle 77%. The largest factor is passing matchup, worth 2.5 points toward Seattle.

model_cards.t1: The model likes Washington more than the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Washington. Sum = SEA -5.5.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Washington's margin. Shaded area = Washington win (32%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)

model_cards.t1: Washington is missing 3.1 starters' worth of snaps.
model_cards.t2: Injuries move the line 1.5 points toward Seattle.
model_cards.sub: Players listed Out, Doubtful or Questionable, weighted by recent snap share. QBs are in the QB factor.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Weight = snap share (last 4 games) x status (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.85, Questionable 0.25)

model_cards.t1: The biggest unit gap: Seattle's pass defense.
model_cards.t2: 0.07 EPA per play better than Washington's.
model_cards.sub: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play vs. league average, the inputs to the model. Right = better.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Recency-weighted, last season's plays at 35% weight

model_cards.t2: It trails the market: Brier 0.226 vs. 0.211.
model_cards.sub: Walk-forward backtest, 2018-2025 (2087 games). Each season uses only earlier data.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Brier score: lower is better · market = closing line
